packageRules.description: Language/interpreter runtimes are never automerged by Renovate itself. The rule above automerges every digest/pin/patch/minor update, and Renovate calls a Python 3.12->3.14 bump 'minor' because 3.x IS the minor field in its version model -- so without this an interpreter upgrade self-merges on the daily run. Must stay AFTER that rule: package rules apply in order, last match wins. The renovate-automerge CronJob holds these too, but it is a separate mechanism and does not govern Renovate's own merging.

George's own images (ghcr.io/gjcourt/*) pinned to YYYY-MM-DD-<sha7>. Renovate's default docker versioning reads 2026-07-26-c14b782 as version 2026 with suffix -07-26-c14b782 and only offers tags with the SAME suffix, so it never proposed a newer build (homelab has never had a Renovate bump of one). This regex orders the date as major.minor.patch and REQUIRES the sha (unnamed group: matched, never compared), so the floating bare-date tag (YYYY-MM-DD, re-pointed on every build that day) is not a valid version and a pin can never move to it. Builds from the same day compare equal; the next day's build supersedes them. These PRs deploy George's own code, so never automerge; keep these rules AFTER the automerge rule above (last match wins).

Legacy pins of George's images in the old YYYY-MM-DD / YYYY-MM-DD-N form (5 as of 2026-10-01). Same date ordering, with -N as a build number and an optional sha, so these can move up to the current YYYY-MM-DD-<sha7> builds. Never automerge.
